name: 长征十号红色10专属标志
content: Red stylized 10 logo from the CZ-10B first-stage livery. Not the second-stage red dragon or small red emblem. Transparent background; original glyph shape preserved.
reuse_notes: Alpha is opacity, not specular. Use a cutoff decal material. Visible glyph rectangle: top-left pixel coordinates (16,9)-(495,247); rest is transparent padding. DDS stored in the standard vertically flipped game orientation.
